artifacts.notes: Extent as the retrieving lane measured it: Complete uncorrected OCR of Migne, Patrologia Latina vol. 105 (Theodulf, Amalarius), whole volume; searched entire for the Offertory and the other appointed incipits. Uncorrected optical recognition: it is a locating and searching layer, not a text of record, and wording quoted from this volume was collated against page images rather than taken from here. The lane's bounded negative on Amalarius -- that a whole-volume search for 'Immittet', 'Immittit', 'circuitu timentium', 'Protector noster' and 'Bonum est confidere' returns two hits, both unrelated exegetical prose -- is a search of this file and is replayable against it.

work.description: Amalarius of Metz's account of the arrangement of the antiphoner, written after his consultation of the Roman books. Chapter LXXIII sets out the September reading and chant course: this run reads it for the assignment of the historiae, where Amalarius gives Job the first three weeks of the month and Tobias the fourth. The composition date is not established in this registration and is therefore not recorded.
